0.content:
Cloud Retainer, the crane adeptus, found the child Shenhe collapsed in the cave after tracking "great evil", took pity on her and saw her talent. She healed her, raised her for over ten years and taught her the adeptal path; other adepti joined in. Cloud Retainer says that of all her pupils Shenhe most resembles her, and that she would keep her close were she not mortal. Shenhe thinks her master a dazzling talker, though in practice Shenhe mostly listened. In 2.4 Cloud Retainer sent her to deliver Adepti Sigils for the new Jade Chamber, hoping she would rejoin society, and told the Traveler to look after "a dear child".

Cloud Retainer now lives in Liyue Harbor in human form as Xianyun. When she walked into Wanmin Restaurant in that form, Shenhe recognised her at once: she would know her master in any shape. Shenhe told her that the revered Cloud Retainer and the master she adores are both simply "Master".

Xianyun is proud of Shenhe's progress, such as the rooftop delivery run, and took her to Granny Shan's toy stall again and again before realising Shenhe did not actually want toys, only liked watching children enjoy them. Shenhe spent over three months' pay booking her a seniors' tour, calling her "my closest kin", which moved Xianyun deeply. Then Shenhe took her polite refusal literally and offered to cancel it. Cloud Retainer commissioned Shenhe's Frostflower Dew outfit as a Lantern Rite gift. Shenhe's ascension lines joke that her master would add more red ropes if she knew how strong Shenhe was becoming.

1.comment: Shenhe: The Red Ropes and Shenhe's Fate
1.content:
After rescuing Shenhe, Moon Carver read her fortune and found both of the fates Liyue most fears: the "solitary star" (cut off from all family and friends) and "disastrous evil" (beset by peril), together with intense homicidal urges. She was a person of supremely ominous destiny, likely to harm herself and others. So that she could grow up safely, the adepti bound her soul with red ropes. These restrain her ill fate and violence but also many ordinary emotions, so she grew cold, "like a lovely yet cold statue".

Shenhe calls them fetters and wards at once. They have limits, which is why she avoids crowds. Since meeting the Traveler, long-dormant feelings have returned, and she says the Traveler, not the ropes, now keeps her steady. Moon Carver also told her that heaven may dictate fates, but mortals write destiny's tale.

In 6.3, Zibai sensed the "dark forces" in her spiritual core and urged her to try undoing one or two ropes in training. True restraint, she said, must eventually come from within. Shenhe said her master had said the same, that she is not ready, and that she will seek her master's guidance.

2.comment: Shenhe: The Divine Damsel of Devastation
2.content:
"The Divine Damsel of Devastation" is an opera written by Yun Jin's father from an urban legend set on Mt. Tianheng. A brave village girl volunteers to face a monster with a hidden exorcist's blade, wins, and is taken in by the adepti, vanishing from the mortal world "like a wisp of smoke". In 2.4 Yun Jin found the father's diary in Shenhe's abandoned village and realised the damsel was Shenhe, and that she had been sacrificed, not a volunteer. She offered to revise the opera. Shenhe asked her to keep it: she hopes to grow brave enough to protect others like the girl in the story.

Yun Jin performed the opera at the Jade Chamber's victory banquet. Shenhe, having just saved the Traveler against Beisht, said that now she could accept the compliments when she watched it. She also said she had not been trying to be a hero; she simply wanted to protect them. Yun Jin hopes she will never be lonely again.

key: The Crane Returns on the Wind
3.comment: Shenhe: The Jade Chamber and Beisht
3.content:
Interlude Chapter Act I (2.4). Ningguang offered to answer any question for whoever gathered materials for the new Jade Chamber. Shenhe came only to deliver her master's Adepti Sigils, but after the Traveler saved her from two swindlers she joined them. She helped find Sunset Vermillionite in the late Sea Gazer's abode and carried it herself. With Yun Jin she gathered ore on Mt. Tianheng, and she crafted the sigils at Hanfeng's Ironmongers. When Beisht, Osial's wife, attacked and knocked the Traveler unconscious, Shenhe remembered her father's abandonment and her master's words and froze the monster's tsunami. She then dove into the vortex after her; the Traveler and Paimon followed, and together they defeated the badly injured Beisht, who escaped into the depths. Shenhe judged it too risky to pursue and expected her not to return any time soon.

Asked for a question of her own, she asked Ningguang whether she could fit in in Liyue Harbor. The answer was that it depends on her own sense of belonging. Cloud Retainer said things would hardly have gone so smoothly without Shenhe, and asked the Traveler to take good care of "a dear child". After the banquet opera Shenhe told Yun Jin she thought she had found the opportunity she needed to change.

4.comment: Shenhe: Her Father and the Cave
4.content:
Shenhe's mother died when she was five. Her father loved his wife dearly; his grief turned to resentment and obsession, and he wandered for almost a year seeking a way to revive her. He returned in joyful frenzy with the art of "Fate Transference" and took his daughter to a cave behind their home as a "surprise". There he summoned a black creature with blood-red eyes, which his notes and the village record identify as an evil god's remains. He told her she was a cursed child whose death would bring his wife back, then left her. She waited for him to come back for days before realising he never would. Armed with her mother's exorcism dagger and then a Vision, she fought it off until Cloud Retainer found her.

Her father later took his own life, and the village emptied. Mingjun, his close friend, admits he could have stopped the ritual and did not. Shenhe told him it would have made no difference: there was nothing her father would not have done for his true love. She still remembers the taste of a bowl of noodles from home and does not know why she has to. Her Heartstring Noodles are her attempt to recreate it.

5.comment: Shenhe: Chongyun and the Exorcist Clan
5.content: Shenhe comes from a branch family of the same exorcist clan as Chongyun, who realises with dismay that family seniority makes her his "Auntie Shenhe". The clan elders heard she was alive, prepared gifts and chose an auspicious day for a reunion, but she is almost impossible to find. Shenhe can hardly believe she still has living relatives. She is willing to help Chongyun's training if he comes alone to the mountains; his family is too sociable for her to refuse their invitations politely. Chongyun calls her an adept exorcist, though her father taught her nothing of exorcism.

6.content:
Ganyu, seeing Wanmin swamped while Xiangling travelled for recipes, introduced Shenhe to Chef Mao as a server, and Chef Mao says he could not have coped without her. Shenhe deals with strange customers by reasoning first and threatening second. She has learned a few dishes, recalls her friends' usual orders, and talks about taking leave to visit her master. Once she ran across rooftops to deliver an order and frightened the customer by landing on the doorstep.

In 5.4 she cooked Grilled Tiger Fish and Jueyun Chili Chicken for the Traveler and Paimon, overheated the stove, and froze it ("Cryo incarnate!"); the flash-frozen chicken turned out delicious. During the 7.1 Moonchase event (limited), Xiangling left her alone in charge of the food street, with orders to watch for dine-and-dashers.

7.content:
The Traveler and Paimon helped her against two swindlers on her first day in the harbour, and she resolved to help them in return. The Traveler is the first person whose company stirred her buried feelings. She tells them she will always defer to them even when she does not follow their reasoning, that she grows stronger beside them, and that what saves her from herself is them. She asks them to stay by her side. In the Serenitea Pot she greets them "as family does" and wants to celebrate holidays together.

Canon presents this as intense trust and devotion; her teapot line that her feelings are "not only of gratitude" is left undefined. Do not convert it into a confirmed romance. Cloud Retainer once told Shenhe how the Traveler panicked when falling from the first Jade Chamber, which Shenhe found amusing and promptly tried to use as conversation practice.

8.content: Cloud Retainer introduced Shenhe and Ganyu at Lantern Rite (2.4, limited event). Ganyu knew her only from stories of her temper and wondered whether she was just bored and needed work. Later she did find her the job at Wanmin. Shenhe heard many stories about Ganyu from their master and found her different from what she imagined, but keeps that to herself. She notes that integrating into mortal life costs Ganyu endless work.

key: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon
9.comment: Shenhe: Zibai and the 6.3 Lantern Rite
9.content: After the 6.3 (Luna IV) Lantern Rite, Zibai stormed into Wanmin demanding the proprietor while Shenhe was minding it. Zibai mistook her for "that Crane Adeptus" who planted mint (Mountain Shaper, by the wiki's link). Shenhe, puzzled, offered her food and a Qingxin eye tonic. Zibai apologised to "Miss Crane", read the forces bound by her ropes, and urged her to start loosening them. Shenhe answered that she is not ready yet. This epilogue was released during the event but remains available as a story quest.

10.comment: Shenhe: Lantern Rite and festival appearances
10.content: Limited-time event appearances, canon but not universally known. In Fleeting Colors in Flight (2.4) she brought food from the city to Mt. Aocang because she had heard friends share food at Lantern Rite. She met Ganyu there, then told the Traveler at the harbour that she wished Lantern Rite could go on indefinitely. In Of Drink A-Dreaming (2.5) she travelled to Angel's Share in Mondstadt simply because the Traveler is her friend. She asked for something like Qingxin, received a sweet "Snow-Covered Kiss", and likened the feeling to the elation of watching a new sprout break through the soil. In The Exquisite Night Chimes (3.4) she was training at Mt. Aocang and helped Xiao fish out the Traveler. In Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze (4.4) she played along with Xianyun's plan for Gaming and his father with some intentionally awkward small talk.

11.content: When first brought to Mt. Hulao, the child Shenhe would not speak and only climbed to watch the sea of clouds. Cloud Retainer carved her a comb of white jade from a sacred stone: brushing her hair three times would mark the rite of entering adeptal tutelage. Shenhe did it without hesitation. With the first stroke a layer of black hair turned frost-silver, after the second only half stayed dark, and after the third it was all white. She still carries the comb. The three strokes mean: uproot useless anxiety, forsake joy and sorrow, and walk the path into old age without regret.
